verdict.rationale: Fern content is authored in Markdown and generated from OpenAPI specs that live in your own source repository, where Fern Agent and Automations open pull requests. The core is open source, a self-hosted container option exists, and every page is served as clean Markdown, so your core content already sits in open, portable formats. There is no documented export or offboarding path, though, and nothing covers getting out platform-held data such as analytics, reader feedback or Ask Fern history. Missing for 10: explicit documented data-export or migration-out tooling, export of analytics, feedback and Ask Fern data in open formats, independent hands-on confirmation of leaving Fern.
